text: Tesla reported quarterly revenue of $27.4 billion, ahead of the $26.1 billion consensus, but automotive gross margin fell to 15.8% from 18.4% a year earlier. The company cut its full-year delivery guidance by roughly 4%, citing softer demand in Europe. Management said it will accelerate a cost-reduction programme it expects to offset part of the margin pressure.
